packs.title: The Hotel Between Tuesdays
packs.premise: Ms Between, a six-armed cuttlefish receptionist, runs a hotel for guests stranded between peculiar destinations. Yesterday the snail porter worries that useful service always means arriving faster.
packs.arc: Prepare extraordinary rooms, welcome familiar travelers, and help Yesterday discover that remembering a guest's needs matters more than speed. The hotel becomes a place to belong, not just somewhere to pass through.
packs.signature: Cutaway rooms with impossible illustrated views, fixed brass service stations, luggage of absurd scale, and consistent warm hotel signage grounding every strange setting.

scenes.title: The Bell Before the Door
scenes.setup: The hotel entrance is drawn behind a reception desk whose bell is hidden in an oversized ice cube.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the bell's ice target, then SPIN its exposed high-pressure ringer. A separate WARM welcome seal at 25–45° finishes the greeting; the illustrated door opens only in the payoff. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: Ms Between answers before the bell stops ringing. Yesterday arrives with the welcome mat, only slightly after the welcome.

scenes.title: A Room With a View of Monday
scenes.setup: A window displays a rainy Monday while two fixed bedside maintenance targets show a frozen curtain catch and an empty flower vase.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the curtain catch, FILL the vase, then WARM the bedside lamp at 30–50° and 10–40% pressure. The weekday outside is a before/after illustration, not a clock-driven state.
scenes.payoff: The window reveals the one pleasant minute of Monday. Yesterday writes it down so the next guest can see it too.

scenes.title: A Pillow That Woke Up Early
scenes.setup: A grumpy cloud-shaped pillow waits beside a frozen blanket badge and a small dotted bedside snowbank.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE the snowbank footprint, melt the blanket badge's ice cap, and WARM a separate bedtime charm at 20–35° with 10–35% pressure. Both preparations must finish before the charm responds.
scenes.payoff: The pillow finally yawns and settles. Ms Between awards Yesterday a silent bell for especially considerate room service.

scenes.title: Check-In for a Raincloud
scenes.setup: A raincloud guest hovers decoratively above two empty umbrella-shaped basins; its luggage tag is encased in ice on a fixed stand.
scenes.puzzle: FILL both basins directly, then melt the luggage-tag block. Their completion unlocks a 25–45° WARM guest badge. Rain falls only in the ending, with no simulated collection before success. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The cloud signs with a tiny rainbow. Yesterday produces an umbrella for the luggage rather than for himself.

scenes.title: Breakfast at Almost Midnight
scenes.setup: Two adjacent room-service trays belong to a sleepy sun and an energetic moon, with contrasting temperature labels on their warming stations.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the shared serving hatch's ice cap, FILL both drink cups, then WARM the sun's station at 50–70° and the moon's at 20–40°, both using 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The guests exchange dishes and decide they prefer each other's breakfast. The temperature choices remain on the receipt as helpful suggestions.

scenes.title: The Staircase Takes Annual Leave
scenes.setup: The drawn staircase is enjoying a holiday postcard while three marked temporary stair sections await construction beside it.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE all three fixed stair footprints, then melt the luggage trolley's release badge and SPIN its stationary axle. The trolley climbs only in the ending; ice steps are not simulated supports.
scenes.payoff: The staircase returns carrying souvenirs and finds everything handled. Yesterday receives a postcard addressed to The Reliable One.

scenes.title: The Suitcase With a Conservatory
scenes.setup: An open suitcase reveals a tiny greenhouse cutaway, with an icy latch outside and three reachable service targets inside.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the latch, then independently FILL the water tank and FREEZE a plant-bed footprint. Both unlock a WARM orchid marker at 25–45° and 10–35% pressure; perspective is decorative, not a second physics scale.
scenes.payoff: A bellhop-sized vine offers Yesterday a flower. He carefully records which room prefers sunlight without luggage handling.

scenes.title: Wake-Up Call for a Small Planet
scenes.setup: A sleepy planet fills the honeymoon observatory illustration; its wake-up equipment sits on two fixed bedside stands.
scenes.puzzle: Melt separate ice caps over a clock turbine and a tea cup, then SPIN the turbine and FILL the cup. Their joint completion opens a gentle 35–55° WARM sunrise badge. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The planet opens one eye and asks for five more geological minutes. Ms Between grants a late checkout.

scenes.title: Two Universes, One Honeymoon
scenes.setup: The wedding planners deliver two guests whose half-rooms show a snowy cave and a flowering garden, joined by a shared breakfast nook.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE the cave-side decoration, WARM the garden-side welcome lamp at 30–50°, then FILL two nook cups. Both climate preparations must finish before the drinks station becomes active. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The couple eats facing the shared window rather than either private view. Yesterday remembers which guest likes the blue cup.

scenes.title: The Preschool Conference Wing
scenes.setup: Dinosaur preschool staff arrive with a towering stack of naptime mats and an ice-coated seminar bell.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the bell cap, FREEZE two low mat-rack footprints, and WARM a stationary milk badge at 25–40° and 10–30% pressure. The prepared nursery unlocks a SPIN quiet-time sign instead of a loud bell.
scenes.payoff: Every adult dinosaur falls asleep during the presentation. The hatchlings tuck them in and appoint Yesterday temporary head teacher.

scenes.title: Laundry Delivered by Moonlight
scenes.setup: Sock-exchange staff leave three chilled linen parcels at successively higher service stands, plus a tiny empty guest-bath basin.
scenes.puzzle: Melt each parcel's fixed ice wrapper from above or with nozzle tilt, then FILL the basin. All wrappers and the basin unlock a WARM towel badge at 30–50° and 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The linen unfolds into a blanket fort for an homesick ghost. Yesterday stays outside the fort until invited in.

scenes.title: A Train on the Balcony
scenes.setup: A mushroom railway carriage appears in the balcony illustration; the room contains two platform footprints and a stationary conductor's service board.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE the platform zones, melt the board's timetable cap, then SPIN its departure seal. Both platform sections must be complete before the seal can respond; the carriage's departure is scripted.
scenes.payoff: The conductor offers Yesterday a tour, but he first checks whether the guest wants the curtains closed. The train waits happily.

scenes.title: The Lift That Keeps Fish
scenes.setup: An aquarium lift moves slowly between three floors, carrying fixed-to-the-cabin frosted window targets past the open maintenance shaft.
scenes.puzzle: Use MOTION to track and melt the lift's three moving ice targets, then service its moving WARM cabin badge at 25–45° and 10–35% pressure. A stationary assist stops cabin motion without changing the thermal goals.
scenes.payoff: The fish point out each floor like proud tour guides. Yesterday learns the lift stops wherever someone looks interested.

scenes.title: Two Guests, Four Slippers
scenes.setup: A snow giant and a miniature sun share a lounge, each with two labelled stationary slipper-care stations well away from their bodies.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE the giant's two slipper forms and WARM the sun's two badges at 55–75° and 10–45% pressure. Finish with a shared liquid-water FILL tea bowl; the two climate needs are independent, not coupled.
scenes.payoff: The guests swap stories instead of arguing over the thermostat. Yesterday brings an extra cushion sized for nobody in particular.

scenes.title: Checkout Before Check-In
scenes.setup: A guest from the wrong Tuesday has put its departure card above its still-frozen welcome basket, confusing the reception desk.
scenes.puzzle: Follow a clear target chain: melt the departure card, WARM its seal at 30–45°, then FILL the newly unlocked welcome cup. SPIN the date stamp only after the cup is full. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: Ms Between stamps both cards Welcome Anyway. Yesterday decides that calendars are less important than whether someone has eaten.

scenes.title: Room Service by Tributary
scenes.setup: A cutaway wall reveals one upper reservoir feeding three guest-room basins through visible channels with fixed ice gates.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the gates to establish FLOW connections, then feed the upper reservoir. The three downstream basins must receive actual routed liquid; hitting their illustrated cups directly does not count as delivery.
scenes.payoff: Three guests raise their cups at the same time. Yesterday follows the channels with a tiny tray just in case.

scenes.title: The Guest With an Empty Name Tag
scenes.setup: A coat-shaped traveler worries that its blank luggage label means no room is available. A frozen tag hangs directly above an active welcome bowl, with a separate seal target off to the side.
scenes.puzzle: The MELT tag and FILL bowl are both active from the start, with the bowl directly below the ice. Carve a hole so hose droplets reach the bowl before the remaining ice is cleared. Both completions unlock a WARM welcome seal at 25–45° and 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: The label becomes Guest, with a little heart. The coat sits comfortably instead of hovering near the exit.

scenes.title: A Night Desk for the Night Desk
scenes.setup: Ms Between's own tiny break room is hidden inside the reception model, with reachable service zones arranged diagonally across the cutaway.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the frozen chair badge, FILL the tea cup, and WARM a reading lamp at 30–45° with 10–35% pressure. A final SPIN privacy-sign wheel marks the end of her shift.
scenes.payoff: Yesterday takes the desk without making a speech. Ms Between uses all six arms to do absolutely nothing.

scenes.title: Keys to Small Kindnesses
scenes.setup: Three returning guests wait beside personalized key stations: a cloud's icy perch, a planet's warm lamp, and a ghost's frozen blanket clasp.
scenes.puzzle: FREEZE the perch, WARM the lamp at 40–60°, and melt the blanket clasp. Their joint completion unlocks two shared FILL refreshments; station badges distinguish each job without a new matching minigame. WARM targets use 10–35% pressure.
scenes.payoff: Yesterday hands out the right rooms without checking a list. The guests greet him by name before thanking the receptionist.

scenes.title: No One Leaves Through an Empty Lobby
scenes.setup: The departure lounge gathers the hotel's guests around a frozen route board, two unfinished ice lantern bases, and a shared tea service.
scenes.puzzle: Melt the route board and FREEZE both bases, then FILL two cups. WARM the lounge beacon at 30–50° with 10–35% pressure before SPINNING the departure bell. All prerequisites are within this scene.
scenes.payoff: Every guest pauses to wave to Yesterday. The last room card reads Always Welcome, including on Wednesdays.
